verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and Rust. Its languages overview says every SDK exposes the same resources with the same method names, and the docs show concrete SDK methods (e.g. events.search) and SDK-based trace ingestion and querying. Missing for 10: package/install and versioning details, per-language reference depth beyond snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as documented.
